svg.title: Canary Release
svg.desc: Canary Release. Route a small slice of traffic to the new version, watch its metrics, then ramp up or roll back. Step 1, Deploy the canary: v2 is deployed next to v1, and the router sends it a small slice: 5% of the traffic. Step 2, Compare metrics: Automated analysis compares v2 with the v1 baseline on error rate and p95 latency: pass. Step 3, Ramp up: Each pass raises v2's weight (25%, then 50%) and v2 scales out. Metrics stay healthy. Step 4, Promote: All traffic moves to v2 and v1 is scaled down. v2 becomes the stable baseline for the next release.

g.text: v2 is deployed next to v1, and the router sends it a small slice: 5% of the traffic.
Automated analysis compares v2 with the v1 baseline on error rate and p95 latency: pass.
Each pass raises v2's weight (25%, then 50%) and v2 scales out. Metrics stay healthy.
All traffic moves to v2 and v1 is scaled down. v2 becomes the stable baseline for the next release.
fail → roll back: all traffic to v1
